chunks: And among them is he who seeks the world through the actions of the Hereafter, and does not seek the Hereafter through the actions of the world. He has calmed his posture, shortened his stride, rolled up his sleeves, adorned himself for the appearance of trustworthiness, and used God's cover as a means to sin.
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of those who seek the world through religious actions?
ai.summary: Imam Ali identifies this group as the 'hypocrites of the outward,' whose piety is merely a calculated performance to secure worldly status rather than divine pleasure. This critique highlights the Shia emphasis on *ikhlas* (sincerity), warning that using God's mercy as a license for sin (*istidraj*) leads to spiritual ruin despite their respectable exterior.
